links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT-4 responses versus recommended fifth- to sixth-grade level
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 readability ranged from 10th to beyond graduate US grade levels, average 15.5 (SD 1.9), exceeding AMA's recommended fifth- to sixth-grade level.
links.quote: The readability of ChatGPT-4's responses ranged from 10th to beyond graduate US grade levels with an average of 15.5 (SD 1.9).

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education responses
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 responses averaged grade 15.5 (SD 1.9), well above the AMA-recommended fifth- to sixth-grade reading level.
links.quote: However, ChatGPT's responses exceeded the American Medical Association's recommended fifth- to sixth-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of responses when each question input twice
links.effect: 96 of 98 (98%) ChatGPT-4 responses and 73 of 83 (88%) ChatGPT-3.5 responses were reproducible.
links.quote: Overall, 96 of 98 (98%) responses for ChatGPT-4 and 73 of 83 (88%) for ChatGPT-3.5 were reproducible.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, reproducibility, and readability of baseline ChatGPT responses to amyloidosis questions without testing an active deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
